name: Rendered village house
description: Symmetrical two-storey village house, 12.4 x 9.2 m: lime render with dressed-stone quoins and string course, eight pairs of painted plank shutters, a glass-and-iron marquise over the door, geranium window boxes, a slate roof between rendered gables with two capped stacks, zinc gutters and downpipes, a stone bench. One large ground-floor room, two bedrooms above, two stairs.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
